title: The City Traded for a Fruit
master_style_prompt: Whimsical 3D cinematic animation, vertical 9:16, 1080x1920, 24 fps. A stylized storybook world at miniature tilt-shift scale: soft rounded shapes, handcrafted clay, wood and paper textures, warm golden-hour global illumination, volumetric light rays, shallow depth of field, rich saturated tropical colors (turquoise sea, emerald jungle, nutmeg yellow, mace crimson), subtle film grain, smooth cinematic camera moves. Nutmeg fruits are hero props with hyper-detailed realistic textures. No text in frame.

voiceover.note: Disusun ulang oleh make_voiceover.py dari take qCRdJ2P7IN2cJamLHzpD: buah pala diungkap di tengah cerita. Render dengan --no-scale.

music.note: Musik & voiceover dinormalkan ke -16 LUFS, musik -15 dB di bawah suara, campuran akhir -14 LUFS.

scenes.name: Hook
scenes.narration: The Dutch gave up New York… for this. And the real story is even crazier.
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close-up hero shot of a single ripe pale-yellow nutmeg fruit splitting open, revealing a glossy dark-brown seed wrapped in lacy crimson mace, hyper-detailed realistic texture, dewdrops, tiny magical sparkles. Far in the soft-focus background, a tiny toy-like New York skyline glows on the curve of a miniature globe against a starry indigo sky.
scenes.video_prompt: The ripe nutmeg fruit slowly splits wider open, the glossy crimson mace glistens, dewdrops shimmer, magical sparkles drift upward; slow dramatic push-in with soft golden rim light, the tiny glowing New York skyline in the background twinkles.
scenes.sfx: Cinematic boom on frame 1, sparkle shimmer, whoosh at 'even crazier'.
scenes.note: Hook memakai gambar globe penutup (P1LYqW89TjmTfutZUI73): buah pala kecil & tertutup, supaya belum terungkap. Klip Kling bYmlKZXM8KtFEkJ8ao30 punya artefak batang kaca.

scenes.name: Worth a Fortune
scenes.narration: But here's the catch: Europe was obsessed. They even thought it cured the plague. Whoever owned Banda named the price.
scenes.image_prompt: A cozy 17th-century European merchant's study lit by candles: on a wooden desk an antique brass balance scale where a single glossy nutmeg seed outweighs a pile of gold coins, coins playfully bouncing. Behind it, a tiny wooden toy sailing ship glides across an old parchment map of the East Indies.
scenes.video_prompt: Candle flames flicker, the scale tips down toward the nutmeg, gold coins bounce, the toy ship glides across the map; slow dolly-in.
scenes.sfx: Coin clinks, scale creak, waves and sails.
scenes.note: Gambar timbangan asli dipotong ke sisi kanan (koin & kapal) supaya biji pala di piring kiri tidak terlihat. Edit kantong beludru (C7FaMVCUNaMnSWtHGTm2) gagal: keluar 16:9 & kantong tidak tampak.

scenes.name: Banda Islands
scenes.narration: Four hundred years ago, it grew almost only in Indonesia's Banda Islands. Whoever owned Banda named the price.
scenes.image_prompt: The Banda Islands as a miniature diorama at sunrise: small green volcano, kenari-tree islands, turquoise lagoon, European tall ships approaching on the horizon. No fruit visible, no flags.
scenes.note: Gambar keluar 16:9 (rasio bawaan node); dipakai sebagai pan horizontal dari kapal ke gunung api.

scenes.name: Run Chose England
scenes.narration: The Dutch wanted every tree. But one tiny island, Pulau Run, chose England.
scenes.image_prompt: A miniature diorama of the Banda Islands floating on a glowing turquoise sea: several small green volcanic islands topped with tiny 17th-century Dutch orange-white-blue flags, toy-like Dutch sailing ships circling. In the foreground, one very small island, Pulau Run, covered in nutmeg trees, proudly raising a tiny white flag with a red St George's Cross. High-angle tilt-shift view.
scenes.video_prompt: Tilt-shift camera slowly tilts down; tiny Dutch flags pop up island by island, then the English flag rises on little Pulau Run.
scenes.sfx: Flag pops, gentle drum, flag flap.

scenes.name: This Is Nutmeg
scenes.narration: This is nutmeg, yes, the one in your kitchen. Four hundred years ago, it grew almost only in Indonesia's Banda Islands.
scenes.image_prompt: A lush miniature nutmeg orchard on a Banda island beneath towering kenari trees, morning mist, a turquoise bay and a small green volcano in the background. In the foreground a ripe pale-yellow nutmeg fruit hangs on a glossy-leafed branch, split open to reveal a glossy dark-brown seed wrapped in lacy crimson mace, with dewdrops.
scenes.video_prompt: Crane down from the misty canopy to an extreme macro of the split nutmeg fruit; leaves sway, god rays drift.
scenes.sfx: Leaves rustling, tropical birds, soft crack.

scenes.name: Then It Got Ugly
scenes.narration: Then it got ugly. Captain Nathaniel Courthope held Run under siege for four years, until he was killed. In 1621, the Dutch took Banda, at a terrible cost to its people.
scenes.image_prompt: Somber dusk. A small fortified tropical island with a little stone fort flying an English St George's Cross flag; a lone stylized English sea captain in a 17th-century coat stands on the fort wall, seen from behind as a silhouette. A ring of Dutch sailing ships encircles the island, distant puffs of cannon smoke, stormy purple clouds, light rain. No violence shown, no injured people.
scenes.video_prompt: Rain falls gently, storm clouds drift, the English flag flutters, the captain silhouette stands still, Dutch ships slowly circle; slow orbiting camera. No violence.
scenes.sfx: Rain, distant cannon rumble, music drops to a minor pad.
scenes.tone_note: Respectful and somber: the 1621 conquest cost many Bandanese lives. No jokes, no violent imagery.

scenes.name: Here's Where New York Comes In
scenes.narration: And here's where New York comes in. In 1664, England seized Dutch New Amsterdam and renamed it New York.
scenes.image_prompt: The southern tip of Manhattan as a charming miniature diorama in a magical transformation: the bottom half is 17th-century New Amsterdam with a windmill, a small fort, wooden Dutch gabled houses and tall ships; the top half morphs through swirling golden sparkles into a modern toy-like New York skyline. A small English flag rises over the old fort.
scenes.video_prompt: Magical time-lapse: the old Dutch town transforms upward into the modern skyline as golden sparkles swirl; slow upward tilt.
scenes.sfx: Long whoosh, stamp thud on 1664, light city ambience, music lifts.

scenes.name: The Deal of 1667
scenes.narration: In 1667, the Treaty of Breda let both sides keep what they held. The Dutch kept Run. England kept Manhattan.
scenes.image_prompt: An old parchment treaty lies open on a wooden table with a red wax seal, and it unfolds like a pop-up book into two miniature dioramas: a small tropical island covered in nutmeg trees with a tiny Dutch flag, and the island of Manhattan with a toy-like 17th-century town, windmill and a tiny English flag.
scenes.video_prompt: The parchment unrolls, the red wax seal presses down, the page pops up into two miniature dioramas; gentle push-in.
scenes.sfx: Paper slide, wax seal squish, stamp thud, orchestral hit.

scenes.name: Twist & CTA
scenes.narration: Not a straight swap… but a spice decided New York's fate. Run or Manhattan: which would you keep?
scenes.image_prompt: A floating miniature Earth globe in a starry indigo sky. On one side, a tiny tropical island with nutmeg trees and a glowing nutmeg fruit; on the other side, a tiny glowing Manhattan skyline; a shimmering golden ribbon of light arcs across the globe connecting them. Clean empty space at top and bottom for titles.
scenes.video_prompt: The globe slowly rotates; the golden ribbon shimmers and pulses between the nutmeg island and the Manhattan skyline; sparkles drift; slow orbit and pull-back.
scenes.sfx: Cinematic impact, soft pop for the question, upbeat outro. End on the nutmeg for a seamless loop.
